lessonMappingReview: Real catalog lessons reread: C2-L001 density and normal pressure forces, C2-L009 series and parallel flow networks, C2-L010 surface force, interfacial work and Laplace, and C1-L005 the inertial-frame vector resultant for a material body. Candidate course, skill, prerequisites and C6 reuse were checked.
limitations: Only the explicitly assigned ideal models are verified. Positive network parameters alone do not establish a real-fluid linear steady regime; spherical droplets ignore gravity and shape changes; surface-work statements assume the stated reversible constant-tension conditions.
Literal signatures bind exactly the prose read; arbitrary future prose is not semantically parsed.
Exact choice grammar is bounded to rational or decimal literals and one pi or integer-radical monomial, plus the exact reviewed unit suffix. Arbitrary expressions and functions are rejected.

Wrong keys, units, sources, equivalent choices and figure scales are rejected after rebinding and test-only token or edition-hash replacement. The plausible false prose case with a correct key is rejected by frozen reading, not claimed as a general language proof checker.
Conceptual judgments remain AI_CONCEPTUAL separately from EXACT_ORACLE. Human approval is NOT_RUN and all material remains DRAFT.

cases.rejectedBy: Independently reviewed physical scale or graph curve changed

primaryBeforeKeys: Convert square centimeters, compute mass from density and volume, then apply Newton to a fixed material column in an inertial frame. The pressure difference yields the net axial force; vertical support balances gravity.

propertyAudit.coverage: Integer stage and branch flow-pressure conservation; material-column Newton and subsystem additivity; two-face film force and virtual work; total-area surface work and no double counting; hemisphere balance and inverse curvature. Separate tests cover strict physical and integer inverse domains, nonlinear means, dimensioned roots, continuous versus integer redundancy and fresh plus saved canonical reading identity.

records.assetReview: Column length 2 m is 200 px at 100 px/m; transverse section is explicitly enlarged schematically. Mean absolute end pressures 110 and 100 kPa over 1 cm² yield opposed forces +11 and −10 N, arrows 110 and 100 px at 10 px/N. At separately assigned illustrative g = 10 m/s², mass 1/5 kg has weight and vertical wall support 2 N, opposite arrows 20 px. Isolated net force panel changes scale to 100 px/N: 1 N is 100 px. Acceleration uses a separate 20 px/(m/s²): 5 is 100 px without equating the physical quantities. Final force bars 100 and 80 px give 1 and 4/5 N. All markers and full native image read.
records.distractors: 5 copies acceleration and 2 length, omitting mass. Using 10⁻² for the square-centimeter conversion makes mass one hundred times too large. Weight acts vertically.
records.manualArithmetic: 1 cm² = 1/10000 m², so ρA = 1/10 kg/m. Length 2 m gives mass 1/5 kg and axial resultant (1/5)·5 = 1 N along +x.
records.physicalAssumptions: Inertial frame, homogeneous incompressible material column of fixed mass and length within a trial, straight horizontal tube of area 1 cm², common instantaneous positive axial acceleration along +x. No axial wall friction or deformation. Opposed end-section mean pressures generate axial resultant; vertical wall support balances gravity. F denotes positive resultant magnitude, not a single pressure force. No steady-motion assumption.

records.distractors: Pa, kg, m/s² and N/m measure pressure, mass, acceleration and force per length rather than force.
records.manualArithmetic: Density times area times length gives kg; multiply by m/s² to obtain N. Pressure difference times area independently has the same force dimension.

reviewSequence: All 80 original U3-05 prompts 120–124 were read individually from pinned Git before candidate keys, alternatives or solutions. Primary balances and per-ID exact results were saved first. Then every final candidate prompt, option, full solution and formula, hint, feedback, metadata and provenance was read. Five SVG files were read completely in XML and full native images. Exact root package and binding bytes were compared with the final read author commits before literal signatures were frozen.
scope: Independent AI scientific and pedagogical reading of exact drafts, not human approval or publication.
